detail: Final empirical runs must contain no DEMO observations.
The selected commodity/date scope must contain observations.
At least one non-empty source label is required.
Final-paper freezes reject secondary mirrors, unverified user imports and unknown provenance even when observations are REAL.
Short spans weaken seasonality and temporal-network interpretation.
A pilot can be narrower, but national claims require broader state coverage.
Network inference needs multiple sufficiently observed markets.
Very small panels are unsuitable for stable national inference.
Arrival-based crunch and supply analyses depend on non-missing arrivals.
Spatial/network maps and distance analysis require reviewed coordinates.
Weather-event analysis should not silently represent only a small market subset.
